description: A script for managing web platform test exports and pull requests, including merging PRs and creating new ones based on Chromium commits.

classes.name: TestExporter
classes.description: A class for exporting web platform tests, managing pull requests, and creating new commits based on Chromium changes.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the TestExporter with host, GitHub credentials, and dry run option.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main method to query in-flight PRs and decide whether to merge or create a new PR.

methods.name: merge_in_flight_pull_request
methods.description: Attempts to merge an in-flight pull request.

methods.name: export_first_exportable_commit
methods.description: Finds exportable commits in Chromium and creates a PR if applicable.
